headline: GOLD SMASHES THROUGH $4,000 FLOOR — WORST QUARTERLY DECLINE ON RECORD EXTENDS CORRECTION TO 29% FROM JANUARY'S $5,589 ALL-TIME HIGH
snippet: Gold spot fell to US$3,985.88 on June 30, 2026, breaking below the $4,000 per ounce psychological threshold for the first time since November 2025 — extending the correction from January's all-time high of $5,589 to approximately 29% and cementing Q2 2026 as gold's steepest quarterly percentage decline on record. The primary drivers are Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish pivot that pushed first-cut expectations to June 2027, the U.S.-Iran ceasefire eliminating the geopolitical safe-haven premium, and sustained ETF outflows unwinding speculative longs. Goldman Sachs has cut its year-end gold forecast from $5,400 to $4,900 per ounce, with a bear-case scenario targeting $4,400 if the Fed raises rates outright.

headline: COMMERCE DELIVERS COPPER REPORT TO TRUMP — COMEX HITS RECORD 652,000T, GOLDMAN SEES COPPER BREACH $14,000/T IF PHASED TARIFF PROCEEDS
snippet: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick delivered the refined copper market report to President Trump today, meeting the June 30, 2026 deadline mandated by the White House June 1 proclamation. COMEX copper inventories surged to a record 652,200 tonnes as U.S. traders front-ran the decision while LME stocks tightened sharply. If Trump implements the proposed phased tariff — 15% on refined copper imports starting January 1, 2027, rising to 30% in 2028 — Goldman Sachs projects copper could breach $14,000 per tonne in H2 2026 on a fresh wave of domestic stockpiling, materially improving economics for North American copper producers and explorers with Canadian- and U.S.-jurisdiction projects.

headline: FREEMAN GOLD TRIPLES LEMHI VALUE TO $696M NPV IN FEASIBILITY STUDY — 1M OZ RESERVE, 34% IRR, 2.5-YEAR PAYBACK IN IDAHO (TSXV:FMAN)
snippet: Freeman Gold Corp. (TSXV:FMAN) released the Feasibility Study for its 100%-owned Lemhi Gold Project in Lemhi County, Idaho on June 29, 2026, delivering a post-tax NPV (5%) of US$696 million — a 227% increase from the 2023 PEA — with a 34.4% after-tax IRR and a 2.5-year payback at a base gold price of US$3,650/oz. The study confirms a Proven and Probable Mineral Reserve of 1.0 million ounces gold within a 15-year open-pit mine life, with initial capital of US$329.7 million. At current spot prices near US$4,090/oz, the post-tax NPV rises to US$904 million with IRR at 41.4%, positioning Lemhi as one of the most economically compelling pre-construction gold projects on the TSXV heading into a potential gold recovery.

headline: CENTERRA GOLD DRILLS FIRST EARN-IN HOLES AT CRANE CREEK, IDAHO — US$25M PARTNERSHIP TARGETS SHALLOW GOLD BELOW OUTCROPPING VEINS (CSE:HWG)
snippet: Headwater Gold Inc. (CSE:HWG) announced June 29, 2026 that Centerra Gold Inc. (TSX:CG) has commenced the first earn-in drilling at the Crane Creek Gold Project in western Idaho under a December 2025 agreement allowing Centerra to earn up to 70% of the project through US$25 million in staged work commitments. The 2026 program includes approximately 3,000 metres of RC and core drilling — representing US$1.7 million of Centerra's US$2.5 million year-one minimum — targeting shallow gold below outcropping gold-bearing veins and along strike of known mineralized zones. The earn-in structure provides Headwater shareholders fully-funded exploration at one of Idaho's emerging gold projects with zero dilution to Headwater in 2026.

headline: FITZROY DRILLS 59M AT 1.73% CU INCLUDING 12M AT 5.39% — BUEN RETIRO EXPANDED TO 22,000M WITH FOUR RIGS IN CHILE (TSXV:FTZ)
snippet: Fitzroy Minerals Inc. (TSXV:FTZ) reported June 29, 2026 that hole BRT-DDH064 at its 100%-owned Buen Retiro Copper Project near Copiapó, Chile intersected 59.0 metres grading 1.73% copper from 92 metres depth, including 12.0 metres at 5.39% copper — the strongest high-grade interval returned from the program to date. Companion hole BRT-DDH063 cut 39 metres at 1.17% copper including 17 metres at 2.16%. The company simultaneously expanded its drill program to 22,000 metres with a fourth rig on site, and is evaluating a near-term production pathway via soluble copper sulphate concentrate trucked to any of three copper electro-winning plants within 90 km — a capital-light path to near-term copper cathode output ahead of a pending environmental permit application.

headline: INAUGURAL 20,000M PROGRAM KICKS OFF AT HISTORIC COMSTOCK DISTRICT — FIRST SYSTEMATIC DRILLING ON OCCIDENTAL-BRUNSWICK LODE IN NEVADA (TSXV:MACK)
source_name: Newsfile Corp. / Mackay Gold & Silver Corp.
snippet: Mackay Gold & Silver Corp. (TSXV:MACK) announced June 29, 2026 that its inaugural 20,000-metre drill program has commenced at its 100%-owned Comstock District property in Nevada, marking the first large-scale, systematic exploration ever conducted along the Occidental-Brunswick Lode — a multi-kilometre vein structure running parallel to the famous historic Comstock Lode that produced over 400 million ounces of silver in the 1800s. Phase 1 consists of 15,000m of reverse circulation drilling at Occidental South targeting shallow high-grade oxide gold-silver mineralization, with a 5,000m diamond core program to follow in July/August testing vein continuity at depth below the historic Sutro Dewatering Tunnel.

headline: MAJOR DRILLING RIG ON SITE AT TUSCARORA NEVADA — ICG SILVER & GOLD PRIMED FOR RC PROGRAM ON CARLIN TREND EPITHERMAL SYSTEM (CSE:ICG)
source_name: Newsfile Corp. / ICG Silver & Gold Corp.
snippet: ICG Silver & Gold Corp. (CSE:ICG) announced June 29, 2026 that Major Drilling International has mobilized a Schramm T455 track-mounted reverse circulation rig to the Tuscarora District in Elko County, Nevada, with final site preparations underway and the 3,000-metre Phase 1 program expected to commence drilling within days. Tuscarora is a dual high-sulfidation and low-sulfidation epithermal silver-gold system on the Carlin Trend — approximately one hour northwest of Elko — spanning six target areas including Battle Mountain, Grand Prize, and Kings Vein across a fully permitted, 100%-controlled 10,000-acre land package. The company raised $4.5 million in concurrent financings to fully fund the program.

headline: GEIGER LAUNCHES SUMMER DRILL INTO THELON BASIN URANIUM — LOKI 4KM GRAVITY TARGET AND TATIGGAQ FAULT NOW UNDER THE BIT IN NUNAVUT (TSXV:BEEP)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Geiger Energy Corp.
snippet: Geiger Energy Corp. (TSXV:BEEP) has commenced its summer 10,000-metre drill program at the Aberdeen Project in the Thelon Basin, Nunavut, prioritizing two high-conviction uranium targets. Loki, a 4-kilometre gravity anomaly, will see approximately 10 step-out holes targeting an interpreted E-trending fault intersection with the sandstone unconformity — building on a 2025 breakthrough that intersected uranium-enriched altered sandstone at less than 200 metres depth. Tatiggaq will be tested systematically along the ENE-trending fault zone to define additional uranium-hosting pods. The Thelon Basin is structurally analogous to the Athabasca Basin but remains dramatically underexplored, giving Geiger exposure to one of Canada's most underfollowed uranium frontiers.

headline: SAGA DOUBLES RADAR DRILL CAPACITY AS LABRADOR TITANIUM-VANADIUM MRE NEARS COMPLETION — DEFENSE CRITICAL MINERAL PLAY IN CANADA (TSXV:SAGA)
source_name: Investing News Network / SAGA Metals Corp.
snippet: SAGA Metals Corp. (TSXV:SAGA) reported June 29, 2026 that a second diamond drill rig has arrived at the Radar Ti-V-Fe Critical Minerals Project in Labrador, doubling daily drilling capacity to approximately 400 metres per day as the company advances toward a maiden Mineral Resource Estimate. With 13,149 metres completed across 64 holes — all confirming mineralised vanadiferous titanomagnetite with intercepts including 7.21% TiO₂ and 0.395% V₂O₅ — both rigs are now operating at Trapper North and Trapper South on the 24,175-hectare Dykes River intrusive complex. The U.S. Department of Defense has designated both titanium and vanadium as critical minerals essential to defense alloys, aerospace, and vanadium redox flow battery storage, giving Radar strategic relevance independent of commodity price cycles.

headline: 7 RIGS TURNING AT PLANALTO AS NEAR-SURFACE CHALCOPYRITE ZONE EXCEEDS 100M WIDTH IN BRAZIL — 14,000M COPPER-GOLD VALIDATION PAST MIDPOINT (TSXV:LRA)
source_name: Investing News Network / Lara Exploration Ltd.
snippet: Lara Exploration Ltd. (TSXV:LRA) reported June 29, 2026 that seven diamond drill rigs are simultaneously operating at the Planalto Copper-Gold Project in Brazil, having completed 10,186 metres across 29 holes on the main Homestead-Cupuzeiro trend plus 761 metres in four holes on the Silica Cap satellite — surpassing the midpoint of the company's 14,000-metre geological validation program. Geological logging continues to confirm a near-surface zone of strong chalcopyrite mineralization exceeding 100 metres in width at the Cupuzeiro core sector, validating the copper-gold system at a scale and grade that supports the previously published Preliminary Economic Assessment with NPV estimates that assume materially lower copper prices than today's tariff-elevated market.

headline: PENTO: BIGGER CRISIS THAN 2008 IS COMING — FED DEBT TRAP, INFLATED ASSETS, AND HAWKISH POLICY CREATE PERFECT STORM (MONEY METALS)
snippet: Macro economist Michael Pento warned in a June 27, 2026 Money Metals podcast that mounting U.S. federal debt, inflated asset prices across equities and real estate, and the Federal Reserve's structurally constrained ability to cut rates under Chair Kevin Warsh have created conditions that could produce a crisis exceeding 2008 in severity — arguing the current hawkish stance accelerates the timeline by compounding debt-service costs on an already over-leveraged economy. Pento identifies precious metals and resource equities as the primary beneficiaries of the inevitable fiscal and monetary response when the credit cycle turns, arguing that near-term gold price weakness driven by rate-hike fears is the last entry window before the next policy reversal forces defensive re-allocation into hard assets.
